text:
julia: Hey team :wave: Kestrel-ai org just created. We need a cross-cloud preflight: GPU quota increases, regional egress limits, and a couple of reserved IPs for their inference fleet.
ashwin: TL;DR what regions and GPU types? also billing/org id?
julia: Org id `kestrel-ai-prod`. Primary regions: GCP us-west1 (for training/inference GPUs), AWS eu-west-1 (backup inference pool). Target GPU types: GCP A100 (4x), T4 (32x burst); AWS p4d or g5 for eu-west-1 (initial request 8 p4d-equivalent). Estimated steady-state cores: 16 nodes equivalent. Billing owner: @lia.
lia: Confirmed I'll be billing contact. Need tags: `team:kestrel`, `env:prod`, `billing-owner:lia@redwood.com`, `project:kestrel-inference`. Add them to the provisioning ticket.
mike: Network notes: we'll need 2 static external IPs in us-west1 (for canary LB + failover) and a /24 peering route for VPC peer between GCP and AWS transit VPC. Also request egress quota bump: 20TB/month in us-west1 for first 3 months, then reassess. Also check VPN throughput limits.
ashwin: Adding quota requests: GCP GPUs are regional quotas. For us-west1 I'll file a request for `NVIDIA A100 80GB = 4` and `T4 = 32`. Also need `In-use IP addresses` increase to 10 in the project.
julia: Can you paste the exact CLI snippets / payload you used last time? Want to include in the customer onboarding checklist.
ashwin: Example GCP case payload I used:

```
Project: kestrel-ai-prod
Region: us-west1
Quota changes:
  - GPU A100_80GB: 4 -> 4 (new)
  - GPU T4: 8 -> 32
  - InUseAddresses: 4 -> 10
Reason: Inference fleet for low-latency models; initial steady-state + burst capacity. Contact: lia@redwood.com
```

Then file via console -> IAM & Admin -> Quotas -> Select region -> Request increase. I also open support case with CC to cloud-support.
lia: For AWS eu-west-1 I'll open a support case for EC2 GPU instances (p4d/g5). Note AWS quotas are per instance family. Requesting On-Demand vCPU and Elastic IP increase. I will request 8 p4d-equivalent capacity.
ops-bot: preflight-checker: ran initial project scan for `kestrel-ai-prod` -> missing tags: `billing-owner`, `cost-center`. Attached playbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/playbooks/provisioning-crosscloud
mike: Also: please approve outbound firewall to analytics endpoints (10.10.50.0/24) for metrics export. We need to add a CIDR allowlist to the default egress policy.
julia: Thanks. Two operational constraints to note: region capacity risk in us-west1 for A100s (spotty availability), fallback plan should be us-central1 with quantized models and slightly higher latency. Also reserve a small Dedicated pool in our Dedicated offering for enterprise SLA (customer requests 99.9% for their prod endpoints).
ashwin: Filed GCP support case ID: GCP-REQ-20260304-4821. Status: Pending review. Included quota table and justification.
lia: Filed AWS case: case-0123456789012. Asked for p4d/g5 capacity and Elastic IP quota. ETA from AWS support: 48-72h.
mike: Quick cost sanity: baseline estimate for requested GPUs + egress ~ $7,000 - $12,000/mo depending on mix and reserved vs on-demand. Add dedicated pool surcharge if they want reserved capacity.
julia: Action items:
  - ashwin: ensure GCP quota request includes `InUseAddresses` and `VPN throughput` note (due EOD)
  - lia: AWS case follow-up and attach billing tags (due tomorrow)
  - mike: prepare VPC peering plan + firewall rules and confirm CIDRs (due EOD)
  - ops-bot: run preflight again after tags applied

ashwin: Done, updated GCP case with InUseAddresses and VPN note. Added liaison email. Request ref: GCP-REQ-20260304-4821 (comment updated 14:12 UTC)
cloud-support: Hi all, AWS case case-0123456789012 updated: requested soft limit raise for `EC2 G3/G4/G5 families` and `Elastic IPs`. Internal ticket: AWS-SUP-9987. We'll ping if they ask for justification. Good to include expected node counts and expected sustained throughput.
lia: tagging done. ops-bot: rerun?
ops-bot: preflight-checker: re-run complete -> OK: billing-owner tag present. Remaining warnings: `cost-center` missing, `vpn:required` label not set. See playbook for required labels.
julia: Cool. If AWS responds with a long lead time, we'll shift part of the fleet to eu-central-1 and reduce p4d count. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:
ashwin: I'll update the onboarding checklist with the actual case IDs and add a fallback region step + automated policy to route new customers to fallback if quota not fulfilled within 72h.
mike: I'll draft the peering config and share the `terraform` snippet in a follow-up thread.
cloud-support: Noted. We'll escalate if case remains open after 72h."
